title: Ten Minutes Fast
teaser: A grieving chimney sweep is hired to clear every flue at a manor waiting for auction, and in the nursery he finds a clock that runs ten minutes fast. Tiny handprints in old soot and a penny whistle hidden in the brick suggest the clock isn't wrong at all, and that whatever it's counting toward is nearly here.

title: The Larkspur Cylinders
teaser: A bell-ringer takes a garret in a fog-bound lodging house and finds a phonograph cylinder bearing his own voice, begging forgiveness for a drowning he never committed. Each night brings another recording, and every prophecy on them comes true.

title: The Fare to Nowhere
teaser: Every night the app freezes for four seconds, and every night a silent passenger sits a little closer to the driver's seat. Douglas Whitlow has a cold flask, a dead address, and a growing suspicion that his rider has never wanted to arrive.

title: The Greywell Ledger
teaser: A records clerk receives an unmarked parcel containing a small walnut television that glows only in the dark, and what it shows is her own stairwell. Each night the picture runs a little longer, and the woman on the screen looks more and more like someone she knows.

title: The Ash-Tree
teaser: In a damp Suffolk country house, a condemned woman whispers a promise on the gallows, and an old ash-tree keeps its own counsel beneath the moon. When the squire is found dead and blackened, something far stranger than poison may be at work.
author: M. R. James

title: The Night Count
teaser: At two in the morning, a pharmacist finds a blister pack holding more tablets than the register allows, and the number keeps climbing. Someone has been checking his work every night for years, and he has never looked at the second signature.
